items: items 2, 3 and 7, and the Answers Q4, Q5, Q7, Q9, Q12-Q15
what: It sends their own recoil to their source (the endless ocean) instead of the planet: engine figures recoilAbsorbed / recoilAbsorbedT / recoilAbsorbedC only with ownRecoil on; no toGround and no shaking from their own push; the catcher planted (Q5); the foot load counts only the weights; MOVES.pull.shake dropped; the momentum ledger test (test/powers.js section 6); the copy (tagline, no recoil 'into the planet', no 'momentum is never absorbed'). Pull request #33. Round 1's fixes are in commit 4ea43ef; its record is rex-strength-lab/research/reviews/canon-2-round1.json.
decisions: See rex-strength-lab/README.md, section 'Their own recoil goes to their source (BRIEF-canon.md pull request 2)', decisions 1-14 and 'What moved', and the pull request body. In short: (1) the push back goes to the endless ocean, reported only with the power on; (2) own recoil wins over Bolted for their own moves; (3) his feet carry only the weights with the power on, so the throw's break-the-ground preset becomes 'never' where only his push back broke the ground; (4) every catch outcome where the object reaches him is absorbed with the catcher's power on (planted, never carried off; some catches become slams; a catch is absorbed whole); the fireball's push on the catcher is pull request 4 (Never knocked back); (5) stomp: the upward push goes to the source; the upper-bound caveat stays with the power off, bolted or standing; (6) punch: net zero; (7) pull: no ground shaking, says why; (8) shove: the shover's push back to his source; against a bolted partner at unlimited strength only the partner's rock tears (partnerTorn) or a one-sided paradox; (9) wrestle throw; (10) the arm-wrestle pin with the winner's power and Unbreakable footing reaches the ground whole at any swing time; recoilAbsorbed for the pin is the net of both arms' push backs into the one source they share (presses and table are pull request 4); (11) catch and toss; (12) weakGround keeps its role for catches with the power off, landings, bolted bodies, Unbreakable alone; (13) Collide, jump, sprint, clap, growth unchanged (Collide is pull request 4); (14) powers-off results byte-identical. The ledger: 402 ledgers, 132 of which derive the ground's share from the push (close by construction; labelled so). Known and left: Collide's not-held bounce with Unbreakable footing over-counts the ground by about 1.1% (pull request 4); with Unbreakable footing on and the catcher's power off, a catch he can't hold up reports no push into the ground (pre-existing on main).

lenses.physics: LENS: PHYSICS. First check each of round 1's fixes that touch physics (code-1's one-sided shove: partnerTorn and the one-sided paradox; the stomp caveat's standing-foot unloading figure; copy-1's split of the shove's push back into Ollie's momentum and his feet's friction; code-2's catcher outcomes) with your own calculations. Then a fresh pass: each move's momentum and the ledger closing with only the canon's cases in the endless ocean; recoilAbsorbed(T/C) magnitudes and directions; nothing of their own push reaching the ground with the power on; the ground's share with it off and with Unbreakable footing alone; the relativistic cases (1e20 kg dial and unlimited); the planted catcher's force, slam speed and energy freed; decision 3's foot load; every number the README and the page quote. Look especially for cases round 1 didn't try: other objects and surfaces (ice, steel, soft clay, gravel), real muscle mode, the person object, Bolted on with the power off, unequal strengths (Ollie's own strength), the game of catch's return leg, the toss at unlimited strength. Report wrong physics with numbers.
lenses.code: LENS: CODE AND TESTS. First check round 1's fixes: does each new or tightened check really fail without its fix (revert each fix in a scratch copy and run the check)? Then mutants again: in a scratch copy of the engine, put the push back into the ground one move at a time (throw, stomp, pull, shove incl. the new one-sided unlimited branch, wrestle throw, catch thrower, catcher in each outcome incl. relCatch and the unbounded branch, partner toss, arm-wrestle pin) and try subtler ones (wrong magnitude, wrong direction, both toGround and recoilAbsorbed, a catcher who slides a little, foot load counting the push back in the catch or toss only, the ledger's derived entries replaced by engine figures). Report every surviving mutant. Then code: state handling, every reader of the changed figures in app.html, NaN/undefined/Infinity in text (unlimited strength on every tab with the defaults, Bolted, and the power off), duoFacts' cache keys including every power, the performance of the Catch tab and the two-player effort search against main (time them). Tests: anything that tests less than it says.
lenses.copy: LENS: COPY AND LAYOUT. First check round 1's copy fixes on the page (the shove's split, the sw-recoil hint's rule, duoRecoilWhy's stalled/sliding/torn/no-toss cases, the bolted pull's time, the pin's figure, the slam wording, the stomp's caveat with the power off). Then a fresh pass at 390x844 and 1280x900, light and dark, with the defaults, Bolted on, They take their own recoil off, Unbreakable footing off, and every power off: every tab's verdicts, chips, tiles, items, math lines, effort-box lines and the cards, plus the README section and Known limits and the pull request description (#33, read it with the GitHub tools or from git). Check every quoted figure against the engine, every claim for truth and specificity, contradictions between texts on the same view, the powers-off text unchanged from main where it should be, plain short sentences, plain numbers, no overflow at 390 px. Report only real defects.

prior:
- physics-arm-pin-net-not-winner (refuted): Arm-wrestle pin: recoilAbsorbed.J is the forearms' net momentum, not the winner's push back; the loser's push back is missing and the ledger nets the two OUTCOME: Refuted (not a bug); the skeptic's optional wording applied, no figure changed. src/engine.js armWrestle: the comment now says recoilAbsorbed.J is the net of both arms' push backs (the winner's up, his push x the swing time, less the loser's resisting arm's down), both into the one source they share, which is the forearms' momentum at the slam, and that pull request 4's per-person switches would report the two separately. test/powers.js section 6: the arm pin ledger's comments say the same (booked once as their own recoil). The page's quick-pin item now gives the figure in these terms (see copy-4).
- physics-catch-slam-booked-as-own-push (refuted): A planted catcher's slam is booked and described as his own push back, though about 40% of the momentum hits his chest after his arms stop pushing OUTCOME: Refuted (not a bug); the skeptic's optional page wording applied, no engine change. src/app.html bayCatch, the catcher's They take their own recoil item for a 'slams' outcome: 'Ollie's arms stop part of it and the rest slams into his chest. A catch is absorbed whole (canon), so all of the bus's momentum (140,000 kg·m/s) goes into their source, the endless ocean, and none of it reaches the ground.' Other outcomes keep the old sentence. test/shots.js, the round 1 block, checks this wording for the bus thrown hard 10 m apart at the default dial; it fails on the page at 51782b3.
- physics-stomp-upper-bound-friction (confirmed): The stomp's 'upper bound' caveat is limited to Bolted with the power off, but on friction footing with the power off the standing foot unloads in the same way OUTCOME: Fixed. src/app.html bayStomp, the power-off standing branch: where his standing foot unloads by at least 1% of the foot's momentum ((pB - pA) / pB, from the engine's push) and the ground has a ground-wave model, the item adds 'The lab counts only the foot's blow on the ground: while he pushes, his standing foot presses on it less by the part of the push that doesn't lift him (all of it here | 24% of the foot's momentum here), at almost the same moment, and that partly cancels the blow there, so the shaking it gives is an upper bound.' The comment above the items says so. README decision 5 and the Known limits parenthesis keep the caveat with the power off, bolted or standing. Engine numbers unchanged. test/shots.js round 1 block: powers off at a 20,000 kg-force dial ('all of it here') and at the default dial ('N% of the foot's momentum here'), and with the power on no upper bound in its item; it fails on the page at 51782b3 (no caveat standing).
- physics-readme-what-moved-light-objects (confirmed): README 'What moved' says the plaster reach and presets don't move for objects up to a pickup, but they do for level throws on sand and for the ground preset OUTCOME: Fixed (README only). 'What moved', first bullet: for objects up to a pickup the courtesy ceiling and the shaking presets (rattle, plaster) don't move; the all-out plaster reach falls where his push back on the ground set it (thrown level on loose sand at a 10^9 kg dial: a car's from 640 to 572 m, a pickup's from 791 to 706 m); the break-the-ground preset changes as the next bullet says. Reproduced with main's and this branch's engines (scratchpad pr2/r1fix/f4.js, all-out, powers on, near 5 m): sand 0 deg car 640.2 -> 571.8 m and pickup 791.3 -> 705.9 m (10^7 and 10^8 kg fall too); on concrete at 0 deg nothing moves; ceilings and the rattle and plaster presets are identical in every case; at 45 deg the break-the-ground preset goes from 650,200 kg-force to never.
- code-1 (confirmed): Unlimited shove into a bolted Ollie on real ground: Rex, with his recoil taken, flies off at light speed after his push back tears out the rock around bolts he doesn't have OUTCOME: Fixed. src/engine.js shoveOnce: a one-sided case before the both-bolted clash, for a shover taking his own recoil (standing or bolted: the power decides for his own moves) whose unlimited shove meets a partner held without limit (bolted). He stays put (vA 0, slideA 0, no tearA, EA 0). On real rock only the rock around the partner's bolts tears out: clash 'partnerTorn', tearB, vB = c, recoilAbsorbed {J: Infinity, T: 0, thetaDeg: 0}. Where the partner's ground holds (Unbreakable footing), clash 'paradox', stalled (the contests' case, pull request 4); both carry oneSided: true. A shover whose recoil isn't taken keeps the shared clash, so powers-off results are unchanged (test/powers.js part 1). src/app.html: clashVerdict gains the 'partnerTorn' wording ('the rock gives around Ollie's bolts ... Rex's push back goes to the endless ocean (They take their own recoil), so he stays put and nothing tears around his feet') and a one-sided paradox wording (Ollie held by their power, Rex's push back to the endless ocean, no physical answer); duoFacts counts 'partnerTorn' as broken ground with the harm 'the rock tears out around Ollie's bolts', and models the ground there at unlimited strength. README decision 8 and the bolted-footing Known limit say so. Checks: test/powers.js 6b 'an unlimited shove into a bolted partner with the shover's recoil taken' (shove and shoveBoth, Rex standing and bolted; the Unbreakable paradox; powers off with both bolted still 'rockGives'). With the fix reverted in a scratch copy (scratchpad pr2/r1fix/mutate-r1.js, code1-revert) it fails (144/145). test/shots.js round 1 block: the all-out verdict and the least-disruptive ceiling ('Past that, the rock tears out around Ollie's bolts.'); it fails on the page at 51782b3.
- code-2 (confirmed): Four mutants of the catcher's new code paths survive test/powers.js and test/shots.js: unlimited-strength catch, 'cant-hold-it' and 'wreckage' OUTCOME: Fixed (tests). test/powers.js 5d: a new check that with the catcher's recoil taken every outcome where it reaches him leaves him planted, with the whole stop in his source and none in the ground: an unlimited fastball (slams; not carried off, uAfter 0, slide 0, recoilAbsorbedC.J Infinity, sinkRatioRaw = (M + m) g / bearing), a catch he can't hold up (Rex at 10^5 kg lobs a car 30 m to Ollie at 500 kg: recoilAbsorbedC = the arrival momentum, about 21,500 kg·m/s at the 3,007 kg test bodies) and wreckage (a motorcycle fastball 10 m apart at 10^6 kg, Things keep their form off), each with its power-off mirror (carried off; slides; wreckage's stop into the ground with Unbreakable footing on). Section 6: the catch legs moved into bookCatch, and a slam (bus, 10 m, hard, default dial), the wreckage leg and the can't-hold leg are booked in all six states (402 ledgers); a new check asserts that the stop ledgers saw caught, slams, wreckage and cant-hold-it with the power on and off. All four mutants now fail (scratchpad pr2/r1fix/mutate-r1.js): (a) ownAnchor(ctxC) -> ctxC.anchor 144/145, (b) sinkRatioRaw Infinity 144/145, (c) no 'cant-hold-it' in reachesHim 143/145 (5d and the ledger), (d) no 'wreckage' 143/145 (5d and the ledger). README: the mutant claim names the four found in this round.
- code-3 (confirmed): README says no throw ever gets the new plaster credit; a semi at 30° at a 10^6 kg dial does OUTCOME: Fixed (README only). Known limits, the effort paragraph: the own-recoil plaster credit 'fires only in narrow cases, such as a semi thrown at 30 deg at a 10^6 kg dial on concrete or asphalt, where with the power off his push, not the slow landing, is what cracks plaster; for most throws the landing cracks plaster at a lower effort first'. Reproduced with the page's offPlasterHim rule (scratchpad pr2/r1fix/c3.js: 6 grounds x semi, bus, locomotive, pickup, car x 0/15/30/45 deg x 10^5 to 10^8 kg): exactly concrete and asphalt, semi, 30 deg, 10^6 kg.
- code-4 (confirmed): The momentum ledger's 'adds up to zero' holds by construction in 119 of its 366 ledgers; the README doesn't say so OUTCOME: Fixed. test/powers.js section 6: book() counts the ledgers that hold a derived entry, and the check's label gives the count, computed ('402 ledgers; in 132 of them, mostly with the powers off, the test works the ground's share out from the push itself, so those close by construction and check only that the engine's energies match its push impulses'). README 'The momentum ledger': the same split, with where the derived ones are (the powers-off runs, and the parts the engine never reports: a stomp's standing foot, a punch's and a pull's footing, a jump's push-off and an arm pin's slam without Unbreakable footing, the stop of a catch he can't hold up) and that the other 270 close on figures the engine reports. The breakdown by state and move is from an instrumented copy (scratchpad pr2/r1fix/inst/). Labelling only; no check's pass condition changed.
- copy-1 (confirmed): The shove's text says Ollie gets the shove's momentum and the ocean the equal and opposite share; the page's own figures disagree, by up to 5x OUTCOME: Fixed. src/app.html wrestleShove: with the shover's power on, the Newton item says 'That push back on Rex (33,000 kg·m/s) goes to the endless ocean (below). Ollie leaves with 23,000 kg·m/s of it; the friction under his sliding feet hands the ground the rest (9,900 kg·m/s) while the push lasts.' Ollie's share comes from his motion energy (exact near light speed, momOfE); under 1% for his feet it says 'nearly all of it'; an unbounded push says so. Engine check at the 3,000 kg bodies (scratchpad pr2/r1fix/c5.js): 8,740 kg-force 32,840 = 22,976 + 9,863 (feet 30%); 2,570 kg-force 37,265 = 7,372 + 29,893 (80%); all-out 66,743 = 63,449 + 3,294. The #sw-recoil hint's rule: 'The endless ocean takes the whole push back of the move, the other way: the momentum of what they set moving or stop, plus whatever resists it while they push (a pulled load's rolling, a shoved partner's feet).' test/shots.js round 1 block: the three figures add up to rounding, Ollie's share matches his shown speed x 3,000 kg to 2%, his feet's share is over 10% at the default effort, 'equal and opposite share' is gone, and the hint states the rule; it fails on the page at 51782b3.
- copy-2 (confirmed): 'Nothing of the shove reaches the ground' contradicts the same box's stall item, and the caveat shows when no shove or toss happens OUTCOME: Fixed. src/app.html duoRecoilWhy, the shove: 'the shover's push back goes to the endless ocean, so none of it reaches the ground to shake it. The one shoved still presses on the ground through his feet or bolts, a steady push' (stalled) or 'through his feet, a friction drag while he slides' (moving), '; the lab doesn't count that as shaking.' It says nothing where the rock tears out (unlimited strength), nor, for the partner toss, where no toss happens (duoFacts' new tossed flag: Ollie bolted). The stalled shove's item tests the shover's power (cP.ownRecoil), not ownP, so a bolted shover with the power on gets 'Ollie's bolts hold (or footing holds), so the push presses into the ground under him, and Rex's push back goes to the endless ocean'; with the power on the stalled verdict and tile name only the partner's hold ('can't beat Ollie's bolts'). Powers-off text unchanged. test/shots.js round 1 block: Ollie bolted and both bolted (the box and the item agree; no 'under their feet', 'sliding to a stop' or 'footing on both sides'), and the toss with Ollie bolted (no toss described); each fails on the page at 51782b3.
- copy-3 (confirmed): Bolted pull with the power off: 'a steady load over seconds' is false; the pull takes 0.31 s (3 ms at a 10^9 kg dial) OUTCOME: Fixed. src/app.html pullNoShake, the bolted branch: 'Bolted, the rope's pull back goes through his bolts into the planet, over the 310 ms the pull takes. With They take their own recoil off the lab doesn't count a bolted pull's ground shaking (it never has), so a quick, hard pull may shake the ground more than the effort box says.' (the time from the engine at the effort shown: 310 ms all-out at the default dial, 3 ms at 10^9 kg, scratchpad pr2/r1fix/c3.js); its comment corrected. README Known limits (the effort paragraph) and the card 'The courtesy ceiling and the not-so-heroic presets': his footing takes it as a steady load over seconds, or his bolts over the pull (a fraction of a second all-out), and the lab counts neither. test/shots.js round 1 block: no 'steady load over seconds', and the time in the box equals the verdict's; it fails on the page at 51782b3.
- copy-4 (confirmed): README says each tab gives the momentum sent to the ocean; Punch at its default effort and the arm-wrestle pin don't OUTCOME: Fixed. README 'What changed' names the tabs that give the figure (Throw, Stomp, Pull, the shove, the Wrestle throw, the game of catch, the partner toss), Punch only where the power saves a lurch (net zero otherwise), and the arm pin where the power keeps a quick pin's slam whole (with Unbreakable footing on). src/app.html bayArm pinOwn: 'The swing's push backs, Rex's pushing and Ollie's resisting, go into their source, the endless ocean (They take their own recoil): on balance it takes 3,900 kg·m/s, up, the forearms' momentum, so nothing cancels the blow in the ground, however quick the swing.' (worded as the net, per the refuted physics-arm-pin-net-not-winner). test/shots.js round 1 block: Ollie at a 10^4.5 kg what-if strength, all-out: the pin's figure is shown and equals the table's; it fails on the page at 51782b3.
